summary: Cycle 24 of Phase 5 (suppression audit), the sole remaining open workstream on this task. Resumed from the previous /orchestrate invocation's pause per the delegation's continuation_context (cycle 23's close: 304 sites done, 46 blanket suppressions across 32 local-only files remaining, count-2 tier at 9 files, next target ChronicleInterface.lean or TruthLemma.lean, both 294 lines). Processed 7 files, all count-2-tier, all cleared to fs=0 blanket suppressions (14 sites total), each individually verified via scoped rebuild plus every direct downstream importer's rebuild, before its own commit (7 individual commits): Foundations/Logic/Metalogic/Chronicle/ChronicleInterface.lean (294 lines, 2->0, commit 16f9acad -- setOption and flexible both unnecessary blanket suppressions, zero corresponding warnings), Temporal/Metalogic/Chronicle/TruthLemma.lean (294 lines, 2->0, commit 035d4a3c -- same, both unnecessary), Bimodal/Metalogic/Bundle/SuccRelation.lean (298 lines, 2->0, commit a5cf2221 -- emptyLine unnecessary, 35 genuine longLine sites wrapped including 9 theorem/lemma signatures immediately above the file's 7 pre-existing set_option warn.sorry false in-scoped sorries, none of which were touched), Bimodal/Metalogic/Decidability/FMP/Filtration.lean (301 lines, 2->0, commit 5c301fcf -- setOption unnecessary, 1 genuine flexible site fixed via rw [hx0, neg_zero] at h1; exact h1 replacing rw [hx0] at h1; simp at h1; exact h1), Foundations/Logic/Metalogic/Chronicle/Types.lean (363 lines, 2->0, commit 1e98fc1f -- emptyLine unnecessary, dupNamespace narrowed to 10 declaration-scoped set_option ... in markers over the Chronicle structure and its 9 Chronicle.c0..c5' condition defs, matching Phase 2's structure-projection-namespace finding), Bimodal/ProofSystem/Substitution.lean (390 lines, 2->0, commit 33c52111 -- emptyLine unnecessary, 3 identical unusedSimpArgs sites fixed by dropping the unused List.map_nil argument, a new category), Bimodal/Metalogic/Bundle/TemporalCoherence.lean (398 lines, 2->0, commit 9f13c9b7 -- emptyLine unnecessary, 14 genuine longLine sites wrapped, confirming the Bundle-directory pure-longLine skew now 5-of-6). Suppression-audit progress: 304 -> 318 sites audited cumulative (85 -> 92 files fully processed). Live re-derived local-only in-scope count: 32 blanket suppressions across 25 files (down from 46/32 at cycle 23 close -- 14 sites / 7 files this cycle). The count-2 tier dropped from 9 to 2 files (WitnessSeed.lean 605 lines, DenseValidity.lean 1104 lines); the count-1 tier unchanged at 22 files (20 actionable + 2 permanent exceptions, neither re-touched this cycle). Re-baselined the check-lint-suppressions.sh ratchet (commit 6c394d44): 60 -> 46 blanket suppressions repo-wide (32 local-only in-scope + 14 upstream-shared, unchanged). Plan fully updated: RESUME HERE section rewritten with cycle-24 per-file results, a live re-derived count-2 (2 files) / count-1 (22 files, unchanged) tier survey, five new findings, and cold-start instructions; plan header, Phase 5 heading stats, and the Definition-of-Done suppression-audit criterion all updated to 318/32/25; a Phase-5-body 'Done (cycle 24)' backfill entry added with commit hashes. Full CSLib CI pipeline re-run at cycle end and confirmed green: lake build --wfail --iofail exactly 5 baseline sorry warnings (zero new), checkInitImports clean, lint-style clean, mk_all no update necessary, lake lint zero matches on the 7 prevention categories (only out-of-scope unusedArguments findings remain, unchanged), lake shake exactly the 12 upstream-shared files (zero local-only), lake test exit 0, check-lint-suppressions.sh exit 0 (46, baseline ceiling 46). Sorry census 168 (textual grep, unchanged), vacuous-def census 1 (unchanged, pre-existing false positive), axiom census 26 (unchanged). git diff on all 7 file commits individually confirmed zero sorry lines touched and no proof term/definition/theorem statement altered. Neither Phase 7 blocker was re-investigated (both CLOSED by prior user decision, out of this dispatch's Phase 5 scope) and neither is carried forward as open in this handoff. Task remains PARTIAL pending a fresh /implement or /orchestrate dispatch to continue Phase 5.
decisions_made: Per the delegation's continuation note and explicit HARD CONSTRAINTS, started with ChronicleInterface.lean (294 lines, next count-2-tier target per smaller-files-first), worked down the 9-file count-2 tier's 7 smallest files, stopping before WitnessSeed.lean (605 lines) and DenseValidity.lean (1104 lines) given this dispatch's cycle budget.

Followed the dispatch's explicit per-file rebuild-and-commit granularity ('Rebuild after EACH file ... and commit ONLY when that file is green, one commit per file') rather than the plan's own superseding 'risk-tiered batch verification' text, since the dispatch's HARD CONSTRAINTS section explicitly reaffirmed per-file commits as a user decision and matches the established practice of all prior Phase 5 cycles (each committing one file at a time).

For SuccRelation.lean, wrapped 9 theorem/lemma signature lines that sit immediately above the file's 7 pre-existing set_option warn.sorry false in-scoped sorries, but did not touch any sorry line, tactic body, or the set_option warn.sorry markers themselves -- confirmed via git diff | grep sorry returning zero hits before committing, per the hard constraint against discharging, adding, or relocating any sorry.

For Filtration.lean's single linter.flexible site, could not use the lean_multi_attempt MCP tool to pre-test the fix because its setup-file step hit an unrelated Lean/Mathlib toolchain-version mismatch in this environment (a large dependency rebuild attempt surfaced pre-existing Batteries.Tactic.Alias/Mathlib.Init elaboration errors unconnected to the target file); applied the fix directly via Edit and verified through lake build instead, which was unaffected.

For Types.lean's dupNamespace warnings spanning a structure declaration plus 9 def Struct.field-style condition defs, used one set_option linter.dupNamespace false in before the structure (covering the structure itself plus its auto-generated field-projection/constructor warnings) and one more before each subsequent def, rather than a single file-wide narrowing -- this is the correct declaration-scoped unit since each def is its own command.

For Substitution.lean's 3 identical unusedSimpArgs sites (simp only [Context.subst, List.map_nil] at d'), verified textual identity across all 3 occurrences before using a single replace_all edit to drop the unused List.map_nil argument from all three at once.

Re-baselined check-lint-suppressions.sh once at cycle end (covering all 7 files in one baseline commit), consistent with prior cycles' established practice, and verified the ratchet gate still reports a clean, monotonically-decreasing result (46, baseline ceiling 46) rather than leaving the gain unlocked.

Fully rewrote the plan's RESUME HERE section rather than appending another entry on top of the existing one, per the standing instruction that the resume point must be complete and cold-startable -- prior RESUME HERE entries are preserved in git history, not lost. Also updated the plan header, Phase 5 heading stats, and the Definition-of-Done suppression-audit criterion.

Did not re-investigate Phase 7's two former blockers (both CLOSED by explicit user decision in commit 5d58795c prior to this dispatch) and did not attempt Interface.lean (3048 lines, count-6 tier, deliberately deferred) or either of the two documented permanent exceptions (Conversions.lean, DefectChain.lean), matching this dispatch's explicit instructions.

Stopped after 7 files (14 sites) rather than continuing into WitnessSeed.lean given this cycle's budget, opting to close out cleanly with the full CI pipeline, ratchet re-baseline, plan rewrite, and handoff rather than start a larger file (605 lines) and risk an incomplete or unverified state at cycle end.
dead_ends: lean_multi_attempt's setup-file step failed on this environment when tested against Filtration.lean -- not a dead end in the fix itself, but a tooling limitation worth flagging: it triggered a full dependency rebuild that surfaced pre-existing, unrelated Batteries/Mathlib elaboration errors (Batteries.Tactic.Alias overloaded-errors, Mathlib.Init Std.TreeMap field-projection errors) rather than testing the tactic snippet in isolation. Worked around by editing directly and verifying via lake build on the scoped module, which succeeded cleanly and was unaffected by whatever stale/mismatched toolchain the MCP server's LSP process was using.
